name: council-video
description: Explainer video for the Evolving Review Councils experiment, built with Remotion

scripts.render: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('public/audio/DRAFT.txt')){console.error('Draft narration in public/audio (see DRAFT.txt). Record the lines and re-run npm run voiceover.');process.exit(1)}" && remotion render Explainer out/explainer.mp4
scripts.voiceover: node scripts/normalize-voiceover.mjs --no-pauses && node scripts/align-voiceover.mjs && node scripts/plan-pauses.mjs && node scripts/normalize-voiceover.mjs && node scripts/align-voiceover.mjs
scripts.voiceover:draft: node scripts/normalize-voiceover.mjs --draft --no-pauses && node scripts/align-voiceover.mjs && node scripts/plan-pauses.mjs && node scripts/normalize-voiceover.mjs --draft && node scripts/align-voiceover.mjs
